items.title: Coach's week review
items.body: Every Sunday Coach scores your week and suggests up to 3 changes for the next one, applied in a tap.

items.title: Talk to Coach mid-set
items.body: Hold the mic in Up next, ask "too heavy?" and Coach answers out loud with a one-tap fix.

items.title: Train around pain
items.body: Tap where it hurts or tell Coach, and your plan swaps the moves that load it until it feels better.

items.title: Tell Coach your goal
items.body: Say what you want in one sentence: Coach fills in your plan and protects a sore spot. Not sure on a step? Ask Coach.

items.title: Ask your history
items.body: "Am I squatting more than in June?" Progress answers with the number and a mini chart, right on your iPhone.

items.title: Plateau explainer
items.body: Stuck on a lift? Coach spots a plateau, says why and gives one fix you apply in a tap (Apple Intelligence iPhones).

items.title: What can I eat?
items.body: Monkey turns what's in your fridge into 3 meals that hit what's left today.

items.title: Read a nutrition label
items.body: Snap it → Label: point at the nutrition table, values fill in live, save it as your own food. Free, offline.

items.title: Smarter reminders
items.body: Coach writes your reminders: last time's lift and the number to beat. Drifting? One kind nudge with a 20′ workout, now or tonight.

items.title: Safer community
items.body: New posts, plans and photos get a quick check before others see them. Anything unfriendly is turned back on the spot, so you can fix it and share again.

items.title: Ask Coach as you go
items.body: Building a workout as you go? Ask Coach right on the start screen: name a muscle, describe or snap the machine in front of you, then start an exercise at once or line them up.

items.title: Add any workout
items.body: Add any workout to a day: your own, the library, HIIT or a generated one from 20 min to 2 h. Your sport stays.

items.title: Skip in one tap
items.body: Skip is one tap now: 5 seconds to undo, then it's gone, also from past days and the Calendar. Long press for Stop training Tuesdays.

items.title: Body and Mind today
items.body: Progress now opens on Today: your Body and Mind scores side by side with Coach's call, plus a Mind tile and a 4-week mood calendar.

items.title: Backed by science
items.body: 4-7-8 counts breaths (4, or 8 once easy), training days lift your Mind score, readiness and Mind use your 7-day HRV, and carb loading follows the 10 g/kg guideline.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Undo on the bar works again, ✕ leaves an empty freestyle workout at once, Track live goes dark after you discard a climb, and the Mind check-in chips are explained.

items.title: Climbing live
items.body: Track live on a climbing day times your goes: grade chips, Flash, Sent or Fell in one tap, rest timer and today's pyramid. With a Watch, tap goes on your wrist too.

items.title: Mind: check in and breathe
items.body: A quick mood check-in on Train, Calm breathing sessions in Explore and a Mind score from mood, HRV, sleep and training. On your Watch too.

items.title: Check your form
items.body: Prop your phone up: the camera counts reps, flags short reps, lean or caving knees, and shows the right position as a ghost. Data stays on your phone.

items.title: Where you climbed
items.body: Log climb and Log sport now keep the gym, crag or ski resort. Pick a chip or search maps.

items.title: Holidays clear the week
items.body: Weekly climbing and sport no longer show on away days. Climbing there anyway? Add it for that day with Sport.

items.title: Calendar touch-ups
items.body: Tap a workout in the Calendar day sheet to open it, the Remove sheet fits its content, and your HIIT day is named HIIT.

items.title: A friendlier icon
items.body: MonkeyFit now winks at you. The Iron, Titan and Legend reward icons got the same new face.

items.title: Big polish, every corner
items.body: The player keeps every set, your week stays right after skips and moves, and Undo is there after Move, Swap and finishing a workout.

items.title: Watch workout, live on iPhone
items.body: Train shows the workout running on your Watch. Open it on iPhone, and finish it from there with its summary.

items.title: Push or lower weight where it fits
items.body: Separate push and lower weights now show only on machines that can take them.

items.title: Tidier player
items.body: The Change sheet fits its options, Setup stays in place once saved, and the Undo bar dismisses with a tap or swipe.

items.title: Plan sport on a rest day
items.body: Planning a sport on a day you made a rest day brings the sport back.

items.title: Progress on the finish screen
items.body: See your volume and est. 1-rep max charts, and every lift against last time: +2.5 kg, +1 rep, new best.

items.title: Log any workout on a past day
items.body: Did something off-plan? A past day's Workout tile now lists My workouts, the Library, Custom gym session, HIIT and Sport.

items.title: Clock stays on one line
items.body: The workout clock in the player never wraps, even with a full toolbar.

items.title: Freestyle, in full control
items.body: Line up your next exercises while you lift: Coach picks queue instead of jumping, + Set adds one more any time, and the start screen lines up several before you begin.

items.title: More machines
items.body: Seated and standing leg curl, lateral raise, incline press, seated dip and high row machines, with animations and 3D guide.

items.title: Tidier exercise picker
items.body: Cards line up, variations sit inside each card, and the + never covers the muscle map.

items.title: Push ≠ lower
items.body: eGym-style machine? Turn on Separate push / lower weight in Setup and log both weights for each set.

items.title: Removed days rest
items.body: A workout you removed leaves a plain rest day in the Calendar, no Skipped tag.

items.title: Remove a workout
items.body: Remove… on a day asks: just this day or every Tuesday. Skipped workouts leave the Calendar too.

items.title: Workout page fits
items.body: The big title and muscle bars no longer get cut, and HIIT days show their rounds.

items.title: One Coach button
items.body: Tap the talking monkey at the top to ask Coach, hold to talk.

items.title: Social posts open up
items.body: Tap a Social post to see the full workout, then make it yours: today, any day this week or My workouts.

items.title: Share your wins as stories
items.body: PRs, levels, badges, programmes and meals become stories in 3 looks, with your photo. Don't want prompts? Your profile → Share prompts.

items.title: Clearer Train buttons
items.body: Custom gym session shows your gym, and one Sport button logs, tracks live or plans.

items.title: How it works
items.body: Where every number comes from: XP, plan, loads, readiness, zones, Fuel. Your own numbers, the rule and sources. Something off? Tell us from the page.

items.title: Customise from the top
items.body: The workout page's customise button now sits in the top bar.

items.title: Workout page, all new
items.body: A bold poster of today's workout with the muscles it hits. Tap the figure for Muscles worked and how it compares with your last same workout.

items.title: Make it yours
items.body: Long press to arrange the workout page: Poster or Bento board, colours, map size, tiles and exercise cards or tiles.

items.title: My plan, clearer
items.body: Edit plan is now My plan: your plan in one sentence, tap a word to change it. Variation moved into Mix it up.

items.title: HIIT days, your way
items.body: See your HIIT day on Train, and pick its days, format and length.

items.title: Your whole day on Train
items.body: Every workout, sport and routine of the day in one line, and next week's workouts open to adapt ahead.

items.title: Invite a friend
items.body: Share your code, unlock XP and app icons, and post story posters of your workouts. Add your Instagram, TikTok, Strava or YouTube to your profile.

items.title: Find your friends
items.body: Add a friend by code in People, and friends you invite follow you automatically.

items.title: Week challenge, never the same
items.body: 60 workouts, Easy, Rx or Beast levels, and member weeks you vote for.

items.title: Add supplements in one tap
items.body: My stack has an Add tile plus quick squares: from a brand, scan a label, creatine or your own.

items.title: Train day fits one screen
items.body: Slimmer day card and a shorter Coach card, so Freestyle, Log sport and Track live sit above the tab bar.

items.title: Brighter pickers
items.body: Every sport and option tile keeps its full colours; the picked one gets a white ring.

items.title: Settings jump right
items.body: Chapters now land on their title, no longer hidden under the bar.

items.title: Fuel, clearer
items.body: One tank for today, one Log button, and Magic Snap: photo your plate or your fridge, Monkey sorts it.

items.title: More daily routines
items.body: 6 new ones (hips, shoulders, roll out, legs, wrists, splits), build your own, and Coach picks one for your day on Train.

items.title: Social, simpler
items.body: Stories of who trained today, one feed, one Share button.

items.title: Me, simpler
items.body: One card for you and your level, Settings one tap away.

items.title: Workout on your TV
items.body: Cast button in the player: Chromecast, Google TV or AirPlay show a big timer, your set and what's next.

items.title: Snap your plate
items.body: Photo of your meal: Monkey names the dish, guesses grams and logs protein, carbs and caffeine.

items.title: Coffee and cereals count
items.body: Search foods in Just ate, build a plate and save your usual breakfast. Coffee fills the caffeine meter.

items.title: More free
items.body: Variations, own workouts, PR attempts, full progress and Watch workouts no longer need Pro.

items.title: Clearer names, fewer pop-ups
items.body: Your gym sits on the day card, routines are now Daily, Gym buddies and Live are easy to find, and removing something gives you Undo.

items.title: Real-life moves
items.body: Runs, walks, carries and bikes now move forward, not back and forth.

items.title: Steadier logging
items.body: Workouts past midnight, Siri set logs and Watch supersets work as expected.

items.title: Cleaner headers
items.body: Search and chips sit on a solid bar, nothing shows through.

items.title: Coach moved up, Social is here
items.body: Coach 🐵 now sits at the top right of every tab: tap to ask, hold to talk. Community is now Social.

items.title: Train anywhere
items.body: Tap 📍 on any workout or long press it to train at home, at your gym or anywhere you saved. Home is always there; trip days show the trip.

items.title: Take a routine off
items.body: Tap its ✓ in Explore → Routines or long press it on Train to remove it from your Daily row.

items.title: Daily routines, your way
items.body: Pick the routines you want on Train, or skip them.

items.title: Skipped = rest day
items.body: Skip a workout and the day turns into a rest day, with Recover and Plan sport. Changed your mind? Unskip is right under the title.

items.title: Training somewhere else today?
items.body: Tap the place chip on the day card. Routines now remember where you do them.

items.title: HIIT sessions
items.body: Tabata, EMOM, AMRAP and more. Add HIIT days to your week, build one in Explore → HIIT, and play it with the interval timer on iPhone and Watch.

items.title: Same moves, every day
items.body: Move, skip or plan a sport on any day, any week. A sport day can turn into a rest day.

items.title: Add your own gym
items.body: Gym not on the map? Add your own with a name, an address or a pin.

items.title: Where you train, each day
items.body: Pick where you train each day (home, gym, climbing). Hybrid now fits lifting and cardio together.

items.title: Daily routines
items.body: Stretch or hang every day, 5 to 30 minutes, from Train or Explore → Routines.

items.title: Fuel, set up when you like
items.body: Fuel no longer asks for settings first: set it up from the card or Settings → You → Onboarding.

items.title: Your call on live sharing
items.body: Choose whether buddies see your session live.

items.title: Sport tiles stay put
items.body: Sport tiles stay put when you pick one: the picked sport lights up in place.

items.title: Style follows your layout
items.body: Style now changes your Train screen even after you customised it.

items.title: Gym map, first time
items.body: Gym map draws your zones the first time you open it.

items.title: Tab bar stays put
items.body: The tab bar keeps its full size while you scroll.

items.title: New here? Guided set-up
items.body: Your gym, machines, map and plan step by step, then a tour. Run it again in Settings → Onboarding.

items.title: Community, reorganised
items.body: Your gym today on top, small tiles, and new Plans, Fuel and Tips: copy a member's programme in one tap, share yours.

items.title: Around any sport
items.body: Pick once how gym days fit around any sport, tweak each sport. Sport days get one block on Train: Track live, Log, Prep.

items.title: Your gym in Explore
items.body: My gym is pinned left of the chips: tap for only what your gym has, ▾ to draw the map and add machines.

items.title: Recover on rest days
items.body: The Recover routine is offered on every rest day, next weeks too.

items.title: iPhone and Watch, one workout
items.body: Twin player, double tap to log, Siri and Controls for Start today and Log set.

items.title: Coach on your iPhone
items.body: Quick answers without signal, a recap the second you finish, Too heavy? on the wrist.

items.title: Say it, point it
items.body: Say "eight at eighty" to log a set, compass on hikes, point the camera at a machine.

items.title: Zones and race plans
items.body: Heart-rate zones on your Watch, run plans for your next race, runs sent to Apple's Workout app.

items.title: Health, alarms, Smart Stack
items.body: Effort and mood go to Apple Health, rest timers ring through Silent, the Smart Stack shows the right card.

items.title: Swim, box, time it
items.body: Watch swim player, boxing rounds that count punches, Tabata, EMOM and AMRAP on a big screen.

items.title: Ride with power
items.body: Pair power meter, cadence and heart-rate strap with Apple Watch, ride by zones, test your FTP.

items.title: Rest days that recover
items.body: A short routine for what you trained hardest and a guided cool-down on Apple Watch.

items.title: Get ready for your sport
items.body: Season blocks for ski, padel, climbing, running, surf and football.

items.title: Skill tree
items.body: Unlock pull-ups, pistols and levers level by level, with a skill of the month.

items.title: Programmes for life's moments
items.body: Pregnancy, after birth, 50+ and back to training: safe swaps that say why.

items.title: Train with buddies
items.body: Share live sets with a gym buddy, get Watch cheers, join the weekly challenge room.

items.title: Liquid Glass
items.body: On iOS 26 the tab bar and sheets turn to glass. Now needs iOS 18 or later.

items.title: Can't train today?
items.body: Long press the day card or a day: Skip today. Not moved, Next up moves on, Unskip any time.

items.title: Next up, right on the day
items.body: On the Train day card the Next up chip now sits on the day's line.

items.title: Past days, one look
items.body: Pick an earlier day: one card with everything you logged, ready to edit.

items.title: Your shakes, one tap
items.body: Huel, yfood and your supplements, one tap in Just ate and the meal plan.

items.title: Made for iPhone Duo
items.body: Folded: Coach sits on the tab rail and the player shows bigger moves.

items.title: Half open, like a book or a stand
items.body: On iPhone Duo the player fits how you hold it: on a table, like a book, or stood up with a giant timer.

items.title: Opens instantly, offline too
items.body: Your photo, account, Community and Pro are kept on the phone, so nothing waits on the network.

items.title: Fixes without waiting
items.body: Some fixes and new recipes now arrive without an app update.

items.title: Extra workouts, your way
items.body: Edit the session flow of a quick extra, and Upper body is upper body only.

items.title: Full screen on iPhone Duo
items.body: The app now fills the whole screen on iPhone Duo.

items.title: One profile
items.body: Name, photo, posts, followers and community options, all on one Your profile page.

items.title: Scans know a beer from a cheese 🍺
items.body: Barcode first, drinks and 29 more foods, and a check list with Fix for anything unsure.

items.title: Supplements on your schedule
items.body: Times a day, days, courses, cycles and reminders.

items.title: Freestyle, smoother
items.body: Pick, do, pick. Your trail on top, Coach picks always ready.

items.title: Just ate, smarter
items.body: The lime + opens on the meal you're at, with ideas for it. Meals you ticked today show with Undo, and the hand portions have names.

items.title: Meal plans fixed
items.body: Tap your plan to edit it, or hold it to delete. The basket and budget now count only the days you plan meals.

items.title: Meal plans your way
items.body: Name your plans, pick the meals for each day (weekday dinners, lunch too at the weekend) and set the dates each one runs. Fuel › Plan.

items.title: Just ate? Tap +
items.body: Fuel shows your next planned meal with Ate it and Swap. The lime + logs a planned meal, a recent recipe or a palm of protein in two taps.

items.title: Train, tidier
items.body: Coach Monkey shows your week as three tiles, and the day card puts Add workout and Plan sport side by side.

items.title: One button for you
items.body: Tap your photo top right on any tab: profile, level and Settings in one place.

items.title: Community got fun
items.body: Workouts in their own colours, Coach Monkey jokes, 🦍 and 🍌 cheers, Trained today, and PR, streak and level-up cards.

items.title: Any watch counts
items.body: A gym workout from Garmin, Polar, Coros or Suunto in Apple Health shows on its session. Mark it done or log your sets.

items.title: Garmin is coming
items.body: Settings › Watches › Garmin watch is ready for the MonkeyWorkout Garmin app: today's session, sets, rest ring and water on your wrist. Coming to the Connect IQ Store soon.

items.title: Buttons say what they do
items.body: Every button now says exactly what it does, Back to today jumps home, and the Watch starts only today's workout.

items.title: Train opens on today
items.body: Train always opens on today, and today's card has Build as I go, Log sport and Track live, climbing days too.

items.title: Away days in their week
items.body: Trips and can't-train days sit in their week on the Calendar. Tap the strip to edit.

items.title: Clear log times
items.body: Log a climb or sport with Started → Ended times, and one How hard chip.

items.title: Smoother everywhere
items.body: Screens, date bars and exercise animations glide, and your data is kept safe even when you edit during a sync.

items.title: Train opens on today
items.body: Today and Start are always on your first screen. Recaps and tips take turns in one card under Next up.

items.title: Only today starts
items.body: Only today's workout has Start. Missed days say Log it, upcoming ones show when they're planned.

items.title: Step out, Undo back
items.body: Tap ✕ to step out of a workout: it's paused, and Undo brings you right back. Finish and Discard live in the workout map.

items.title: Rest in its place
items.body: Rest shows a big timer and bar in the set card's spot, with +15 s and Skip rest right there.

items.title: Undo, not "Are you sure?"
items.body: Deleting a measurement, recipe, workout or plan item happens at once, with Undo.

items.title: Easier to read
items.body: Text follows your iPhone's text size, light cards use dark text, and buttons are easier to tap.

items.title: Explore, clearer
items.body: Pick Exercises or Ready-made, then browse by muscle, machine or type. Muscles shows what you worked most this week.

items.title: Jump around an exercise
items.body: A sticky bar on each exercise takes you straight to muscles, your stats, setup, form or similar moves.

items.title: Fuel days slide
items.body: Slide Fuel's date bar day by day like Train's week strip. Days are coloured by load: big day, training day or rest.

items.title: What I have: one box
items.body: Search every food from one box and add what's in your fridge in a few taps.

items.title: Supplements and shakes
items.body: Supplements and meal shakes in Fuel: on your timeline, with a caffeine check for your sleep.

items.title: Train is cleaner
items.body: Wall session shows on climbing days only.

items.title: Sport prep
items.body: Sport days get a warm-up and a stretch.

items.title: Fuel tools at hand
items.body: Fuel tools sit right under the date bar, and your next meal offers recipes from what you have.

items.title: Water reminders
items.body: Water reminders that follow your training, with +1 right on the banner, widget and Watch.

items.title: Hold a day
items.body: Touch and hold a workout day in the week strip on Train to move it, swap it with another workout, edit it or plan a sport that day.

items.title: Build as I go
items.body: Unplanned session? Start empty and add exercises as you train. Coach suggests what's next.

items.title: Start fresh
items.body: Want a totally new plan? Training profile → Start fresh. Keep your answers or answer again; history, PRs and XP stay.

items.title: Fuel
items.body: New tab: food pointers for each day's training, 200+ recipes, meal plans, a grocery list and a fridge scan.

items.title: Monkey grows with you
items.body: Every 4 weeks a block review levels your plan up, auto-tune fits each day's workout to your sleep and sore muscles, and your growth path shows when you'll hit your goal.

items.title: Built for heavy lifters
items.body: Peak a lift for a test day with Lift Focus, pick top sets, drops or myo-reps per exercise, and see your rep records in Lift Lab.

items.title: Rewards for every day
items.body: Streak shields save a missed week, a Comeback quest after a break, and every finish shows 3 wins, even on a tough day.

items.title: Smooth week strip
items.body: Slide the week strip on Train day by day. The day in the middle is magnified and opens in the card, and the strip stays where you left it.

items.title: Any day, right in the card
items.body: Tap any day in the week strip on Train and it opens in the card, last week and coming weeks included. Coming workout days let you plan a sport or move the workout.

items.title: Cleaner Explore menu
items.body: One bar: tap a section and it lights up in its colour.

items.title: Plan your sports
items.body: Climbing, snowboard, bike… each sport is a card with its days in Your week. Tap a coming day to plan a sport once, every week or a whole trip: no gym those days.

items.title: Next up looks ahead
items.body: Week done? The Train card shows next week's first workout instead of Week complete.

items.title: Never miss a chest
items.body: Finished your week on the Watch? The chest still opens on Train. Progress now shows your week's XP and every chest.

items.title: Share any sport
items.body: Runs, rides, ski days and climbs now go to Community, and auto share never misses a workout.

items.title: A livelier Explore
items.body: A big colour card shows what's new in each section, from this week's sets to your last workout, and colourful icons switch between them.

items.title: Swipe through your weeks
items.body: Today sits in the middle of the week strip on Train. Swipe back a week or two weeks ahead.

items.title: Log a climb like any sport
items.body: Logging a climb now looks like Log sport, with quick grade chips.

items.title: Track on your Watch from Train
items.body: The Watch button and Track live show up as soon as your Watch is connected, under a full-width Start workout.

items.title: Pick your sport faster
items.body: Your sports sit on top as big cards, the rest in bold colour groups, in Log sport and Track on Watch.

items.title: Report a problem
items.body: Shake your phone or go to Settings to tell us what went wrong, with a screenshot. We read every report.

items.title: Stay signed in
items.body: Fixed random sign-outs when the connection dropped at the wrong moment.

items.title: Every step counts
items.body: Walking and stairs from Apple Health now earn XP toward your level, with a gentle nudge on quiet days.

items.title: Explore by machine
items.body: A new Machines tab lists every machine with its exercises, and machine chips filter the muscle lists. Switch on "in my gym" to see only yours.

items.title: Meet MonkeyFit
items.body: A short new name on your Home Screen and a bold kettlebell icon, on iPhone and Watch.

items.title: Maps for your sports
items.body: Ski runs vs lifts, hike and ride profiles with splits, and a live trail on your Watch.

items.title: Start on your Watch from the iPhone
items.body: Track live in Log sport, or tap the Watch button on Train. Hyrox is now in Explore.

items.title: Log a sport in seconds
items.body: Pick the sport and everything sits on one card: time, duration and how hard.

items.title: Your History
items.body: Every session on one timeline, with search and sport filters.

items.title: Progress, your way
items.body: Build your Progress board with widgets and add a card for each of your sports.

items.title: Hyrox ready
items.body: A race-prep programme that fits all your Hyrox races, paced from your goal time.

items.title: Chest & Back trainer workout
items.body: A new trainer plan in the library, ready to start.

items.title: Auto save
items.body: Edits save themselves. Tap Undo when you leave if you change your mind; drafts of new workouts wait for you.

items.title: One profile page
items.body: Photo, name, nickname, about and how we talk to you, all in one place.

items.title: Find a gym near a place
items.body: Place suggestions as you type, and typos are fixed for you.

items.title: Safer sign-in and sync
items.body: Stronger protection for your account, and sync no longer loses or brings back changes.

items.title: Every sport counts
items.body: Log or track snowboard, MTB, hikes, dives and more on your Watch, and your gym plan works around them.

items.title: Hyrox on your wrist
items.body: Race with only your Watch: every run, station and Roxzone recorded by itself, then a full race report.

items.title: Snow ready
items.body: An 8-week pre-season programme for skiers and snowboarders, fitted to your first day on snow.

items.title: How we talk to you
items.body: Pick your pronouns and what Coach calls you. Coach cheers you by name at the big moments.

items.title: Smoother map, sharper sensor
items.body: Drag gym map blocks freely: they snap, push others aside and swap. The lift sensor now needs real travel per lift, so wobble no longer counts.

items.title: Ask Coach everywhere
items.body: Tap the 🐵 on any screen or just talk. Say “done” or “80 kg” mid-set.

items.title: Anatomy in the position guide
items.body: Start, middle and end of every exercise on a muscle-by-muscle figure, worked muscles in red, real grips and full-size machines.

items.title: Gym Map
items.body: Scan your gym with the camera, use the map members already made, see your route and what's busy right now.

items.title: Lift sensor, your way
items.body: Pick how strict it counts, tap ✓ to log or let it log itself, and try it live with a graph. It learns from your Crown fixes.

items.title: Coach voice fixed
items.body: Quiet in silent mode, studio voices download, and your coach picks a natural voice for you. Change it in Settings → Workout coach.

items.title: A cleaner Apple Watch
items.body: Bigger text, buttons always in reach and the same bold cards on every screen, whichever home style you picked.

items.title: Pick your coach's voice
items.body: Studio voices, female or male, with American, British, Australian, Irish, Indian, South African or New Zealand accents. Settings → Workout coach.

items.title: See it in 3D
items.body: Every exercise's right position from any side, with the angles to hit and the mistake to avoid.

items.title: Change on the fly
items.body: Swap or remove an exercise mid-workout, or remove it from your plan with a long press.

items.title: Settings, sorted
items.body: Search any setting, jump by chapter, every option one tap. Climbers: Log climb and Wall session now sit side by side, and the wall session has its own page.

items.title: Ask Coach
items.body: Tell Coach Monkey what you feel like today and get a workout made for you, sore spots and busy machines included.

items.title: Coach Monkey in your workout
items.body: Cheers you on out loud, calls your final set and celebrates new records. Pick Chill, Hype or Drill in Settings → Workout coach.

items.title: Bigger moves, log from the lock screen
items.body: The movement picture is twice the size and the player stays in place; Up next opens the workout map. Log sets, adjust kg and see heart rate on the lock screen or Dynamic Island, with a summary when you finish.

items.title: Warm-ups that fit you
items.body: 5 minutes of easy cardio to get warm, a little longer before leg day, in the morning or from 50. Set your usual workout time in Training profile.

items.title: Your Watch counts reps (beta)
items.body: Auto rep count, bar speed per rep and a stop buzz when you slow down, plus machine mode for leg press and co.

items.title: One tap per set
items.body: Tap how hard the set felt and it's logged, effort included. Rest ends by itself with a 3-2-1 buzz, and after the last set you move on in 5 seconds (change it in Settings → Workout flow). If iPhone closes the app while it's locked, your workout reopens at the same set.

items.title: See what's left, any way up
items.body: Swipe the Coming up strip or tap the progress dots for your workout map. Prop your phone sideways on a machine and the player turns into a landscape cockpit with a big rest ring.

items.title: Your Watch joins in
items.body: Start on iPhone and your Apple Watch offers to track heart rate and calories. On Apple Watch Ultra, pick MonkeyWorkout for the Action button: each press does the next step.

items.title: Your gym, your day
items.body: Tap Setup on a machine to save seat, pin and pad positions and a photo for this gym. Change a workout's focus or swap days from its page, split a superset when machines are far apart, and Skip on a missed workout really lets it go.

items.title: Climbing gym days
items.body: Pick Bouldering, Hangboard, Rope or Rest on climbing days and get a warm-up and cool-down for the wall. New Explore → Climbing with 25 drills, named as in MonkeyGrade.

items.title: Start in one look
items.body: Train is tidier: Coach Monkey, Ease In and Next up are slimmer, so Start workout is right there without scrolling.

items.title: Your name and @nickname, together
items.body: The card at the top of Settings now shows your name and your Community @nickname, and you edit both right there. The You card is now Community profile, for your photo and about.

items.title: Real-life moves, every exercise
items.body: All 422 animations were checked again for realism. You sit on the pec deck seat, arms sweep round instead of crossing, knees and elbows always bend the natural way, and hands and feet stay on the handles, bench and floor.

items.title: Your data, safer
items.body: Workouts and climbs are backed up every day and saved automatically when you're back online, so nothing you log offline gets lost.

items.title: Account is now Settings
items.body: The last tab is now called Settings, with a gear icon. What Monkey learned moved from Training profile into your profile card at the top of Settings, with your top liked and avoided moves.

items.title: Log a climb on any rest day
items.body: Climbing on? Tap a rest day in Next up and log a climb right there, next to Add workout. A climb logged for an earlier day is dated that day.

items.title: Coach Monkey card tidied
items.body: Next tip is now a round ↻ button in the corner, and the chips always fit inside the card.

items.title: Widgets for your Home Screen
items.body: Add MonkeyWorkout to your Home or Lock Screen in Small, Medium or Large. Pick Gradient cards, Monkey coach or Data tiles, and choose what each size shows in Account → Home Screen widgets.

items.title: Monkey learns what you like
items.body: Swap, remove or skip an exercise and next week leaves it out; picks you love come back more. Training profile → What Monkey learned lets you forget or block anything. Edit any workout before you start, warm-up and cool-down included.

items.title: Short on time?
items.body: Tap the clock in the player (or pause → Finish early) and Coach Monkey fits the rest of your workout to the time you have: Express, Balanced, Wrap up now or your own minutes. Your main lift goes last, the cool-down stays, and Undo brings the full workout back.

items.title: Train does more, and Undo
items.body: Coach Monkey chips and tips now lead somewhere, and in Next up you can tap any day or log a climb. Closed a screen by mistake? Tap Undo and it comes back with every value.

items.title: Clearer gym zones, programmes and Progress
items.body: Equipment pictures show their zone, with a By zone view. Programme days take their phase colour and Pick a workout can build a new one. On Progress, the section bar follows you to the bottom.

items.title: Every workout, your length
items.body: A programme's page now shows all its workouts week by week, built for your gym and days. Pick Quick, Standard, Extended or Long haul when you start, and change it later.

items.title: 2 new programmes, or build your own
items.body: Athletic engine (6 weeks) and Fresh start (4 weeks) join Explore → Programmes. Tap New programme to build one in 4 steps, or Make it mine to copy and change any programme.

items.title: Missed a workout? Catch up
items.body: Train shows today or your next training day. A missed day turns red in the Next up week strip: tap it to log it, mark it done, do it today or skip. Coach, Calendar and Apple Watch show it too.

items.title: Supersets that stay in one spot
items.body: On the Equipment page, group your gym's kit into zones (or sketch a floor plan). Supersets and circuits then pair moves from one area, and the player tells you Same spot or Walk to the next zone.

items.title: Your gym saves as you go
items.body: Equipment you add is kept right away, no SAVE needed. One Add a gym button finds gyms near you, by name, or sets up home or a hotel. Calendar day sheets now open showing every option.

items.title: Training programmes
items.body: Explore → Programmes: Strength foundation (8 weeks), Muscle builder (6) and Climber's power (6). A programme runs your plan in phases with signature workouts and ends with a PR test. Pause it any time; your own plan comes back.

items.title: Make Train and the app yours
items.body: Tap the grid button next to LV to edit Train: add widgets like calendar, streak, records or body weight, resize and drag them, or pick a preset. Account → Style now shows each style's real iPhone and Watch screens before you switch.

items.title: 10 new workouts, easy to find
items.body: Push power, Pull strength, Posterior chain, Dumbbell full body, Bodyweight anywhere, Machine starter, Core crusher, HIIT circuit, Climber's strength and Mobility reset. Explore → Workouts has goal chips and a search by name, muscle or goal.

items.title: Fluid motion, every exercise
items.body: Fast moves like burpees, swings and twists now play with up to 49 poses, so nothing jumps. Every animation was checked again: hands stay on the bar, bodies sit on the bench and limbs no longer pass through machines.

items.title: Safer account: passkeys and 2-step
items.body: Password, email and account changes now ask you to confirm it's you first. Account → Security: add a passkey to sign in with Face ID, or turn on 2-step codes from an authenticator app. Apple and passkeys skip 2-step.

items.title: Find your way around Progress
items.body: Progress opens with a map of everything on the page: training, body, records, badges, muscles and history, each with its key number. Tap one to jump there; the section bar stays on top while you scroll.

items.title: Week and readiness, one slim card
items.body: Train's week card is now a third of the size: sessions done in a ring, today's readiness as the headline, HRV, resting HR and sleep below. Tap the verdict for details, the week line for your cycle.

items.title: Crisp, fluid exercise motion
items.body: Every exercise now moves through twice as many poses and switches between them crisply, so there is no more blinking or ghost arms while it plays.

items.title: Every update in one place
items.body: Account → What's new now lists all past updates, newest first, so you can catch up on anything you missed.

items.title: Levels that bring something
items.body: Six ranks from Rookie to Legend, each with a new monkey look, rings, level-up effects, app icons and a Community title. Tap your level in Progress to see the whole ladder.

items.title: Smoother exercise motion
items.body: The exercise movement now glides from pose to pose without flashing, and the dot on the path moves with it.

items.title: Your highlights on top of Progress
items.body: Measurements, records, achievements and body now sit at the top of Progress. Prefer a swipeable strip or tabs? Pick your layout in Account → Progress layout.

items.title: Your Watch style on iPhone too
items.body: Monkey coach, Quest map or Level bar: pick it in Account → Style and your Watch matches. Every workout earns XP toward your level, with the same badges on both.

items.title: Turn Apple Health back on
items.body: Said no to Health once? Account → Body & Health → Manage Health access shows how to turn it back on in one tap.

items.title: A real 3D body
items.body: The 3D body on Explore → Muscles is now sculpted like a real body and turns around itself. Tap any muscle to see its exercises.

items.title: Watch complications are here
items.body: MonkeyWorkout complications now show on your watch faces and in the Smart Stack: long-press the face, Edit, Complications, then pick MonkeyWorkout.

items.title: Exercises that really move
items.body: Every exercise now plays as smooth motion: the working muscles glow red, a dotted line shows the path of the bar or hand, and a chip gives the tempo, like UP 1s and DOWN 2s, with your rep. Tap the picture to replay.

items.title: Your body in 3D
items.body: Explore → Muscles can now show a 3D body: turn it, zoom in and tap a muscle to see its exercises. Switch 2D / 3D on the map or in Account → Body & Health.

items.title: Help with every measurement
items.body: Tap ? on any measurement to see where the tape goes, with steps and a tip. Or tap Measure with me to be guided through them one by one.

items.title: Your Apple Watch, your style
items.body: Pick a Watch home: Monkey coach, Crown deck or Charge & go. Every Watch screen follows: full colour, gradient tiles, or game mode with XP, levels and badges. Change it in Account → Apple Watch.

items.title: Live progress tiles
items.body: Progress tiles switch between Week, Month and All, show your trend and the change vs last time. Tap a tile for its chart, tap a day in the calendar to open that workout.

items.title: Tidier Account header
items.body: Your Apple, Verified and PRO badges sit on their own row and your session count is a bright pill next to your name. No more broken words.

items.title: Week and readiness in one card
items.body: Train shows your week and today's readiness together: the readiness pill sits inside the week card, tap it for the details. No Health yet? Connect it right there.

items.title: Your goal, your split
items.body: Switching goal re-plans your week. Under your goal, pick a split (full body, upper / lower, push pull legs, body part…), tap a day to set its focus, and pick focus muscles for extra sets.

items.title: Simpler workout player, bolder switchers
items.body: The workout player fits one screen: kg and reps in one place, tap a done set to fix it, cardio just shows the timer. Explore's switcher is now colourful tiles with counts.

items.title: Watch face complications
items.body: Add MonkeyWorkout to any watch face, analog ones too: next workout, weekly goal, streak, week strip, readiness, top lift, last workout. Long-press the face, Edit, then pick MonkeyWorkout.

items.title: Ready the moment you open it
items.body: Readiness, weight and Health data show at launch, no more Connect Apple Health flash. New exercise closes with the X next to Save.

items.title: Choose your session flow
items.body: Pick the blocks of your workouts and drag the time bar to split the minutes. Per workout, for your plan, or in your own workouts. Pin your favourites too, like 7 min treadmill in every warm-up: Session flow → My picks, or long-press an exercise → Always use.

items.title: Movements play on their own
items.body: Each exercise shows its movement 3 times when it appears in the workout, then stops. Tap Play movement to see it again.

items.title: Calisthenics skills
items.body: Muscle-ups, front and back levers, human flag, iron cross, one-arm pull-ups and push-ups, pistols, freestanding handstand push-ups, each with easier steps.

items.title: 76 new exercises, 12 new machines
items.body: Pendulum and belt squat, row and pullover machines, multi-hip, sandbag, sliders and balance trainer. Add them in Your gym → Equipment.

items.title: Rotate variations
items.body: Training profile → Week to week: turn on Rotate variations to swap accessories for a variation each week. Main lifts stay put.

items.title: Foam rolling and new stretches
items.body: Foam roller and massage ball drills plus downward dog, warrior 2, straddle and more in the library.

items.title: Track your measurements
items.body: Account → Body & Health → Measurements: log chest, arms, waist, thighs and more, see each one progress, synced with Apple Health.

items.title: Custom workout
items.body: Train → Add workout: build your own workout or generate one from muscles, then drop it on any day.

items.title: Quick sessions your way
items.body: Pick 15 to 60 minutes and the muscles to focus on. Long-press a tile to add 30 minutes in one step.

items.title: Switch between your gyms
items.body: Your gym keeps every gym you've used with its own equipment. Tap one to switch, also from Account.

items.title: Gym setup in a few swipes
items.body: Set up a new gym or your equipment list with one swipe card per area, and one item count everywhere.
